prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: a NEW 4 by 4 contact sheet containing exactly 16 sequential square photographs for a slow retro stop-motion exercise prototype, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Reference image is ONLY for the woman's identity, ink-green clothing, dumbbell and warm home setting; do NOT copy the lifted-knee pose into every panel.
Exercise: suitcase march in place, not walking forward and not running. Rebuild the full cycle from a calm standing start. Same adult woman, right hand holding exactly one black hex dumbbell down beside her right thigh (viewer left). Left hand stays relaxed at her side, no arm swing. Both shoes and the entire dumbbell visible in every cell.
New camera: fixed slightly three-quarter front view, only about 15 degrees from frontal so the two legs and planted foot are easy to distinguish. Identical camera, lens, full-body scale, head height and background in all 16 cells. Plain cream wall #F4EEE4, warm wood floor, rectangular ink-green mat #012F2B, small orange towel #E98A15 on a stool at far left; subtle old printed photograph warmth, clean readable body, no heavy grain over joints, no text/logos.
Motion is SMALL AND CONTROLLED: lift each knee modestly forward below hip height, about 35 degrees hip flexion, rather than exaggerated high knees. Bend the lifted knee naturally, lower leg hangs below it. Supporting foot stays flat and fixed. Torso upright, pelvis nearly level, no leaning, no bouncing, no travel across mat. Weight remains below hip with straight relaxed loaded arm, never switches sides.
Exact 16-frame schedule:
1 both feet planted hip-width, neutral.
2 right heel just releases, left foot planted.
3 right knee rises slightly, right shoe 5 cm clear.
4 right knee rises to half of target, right shoe 12 cm clear.
5 right knee reaches modest peak, right shoe about 20 cm clear.
6 right knee lowers to half height.
7 right shoe lowers to 5 cm.
8 right foot lands at its original spot, both feet planted.
9 left heel releases, right foot stays planted at original spot.
10 left knee rises slightly, left shoe 5 cm clear.
11 left knee rises to half target, shoe 12 cm clear.
12 left knee reaches modest peak, shoe 20 cm clear.
13 left knee lowers to half.
14 left shoe lowers to 5 cm.
15 left foot contacts original spot.
16 both feet planted neutral, same as frame1.
Each cell shows ONE person and ONE instant, no trails or overlaid silhouettes. Generate the actual left-leg phases; do not mirror the right-leg photographs because the dumbbell must stay in the same hand. Thin identical cream gutters. Every cell same dimensions and same floor-line position; nothing cropped. 4x4 exact grid. Priority: natural support transfer and consistent body/equipment, not decorative variation.
observations: Panel10 repeats the right leg instead of progressing the left.
Several high-knee frames are near duplicates; source count is not pose count.
